subsetPolicyRationale: `s.wfc.wfc2d@1` is one self-contained WaveFunctionCollapse problem document — free rectangular slots, an adjacency edge list with named relation classes, a tile alphabet carrying inline 2D media, rules and one seed. There is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation reads and writes the SAME value model through the SAME codec and dispatch, so `✳️any` is this artifact's only real scope.
